policy.sharedComponentContract: A new reusable UI component must be used by the product, exported from src/components/ui, and rendered in /ui-kit in the same change.
policy.driftContract: New native-control fingerprints or shared chrome overrides must be reviewed before the generated audit baseline changes.
policy.brandingContract: Custom branding remains limited to the sidebar and its contrast-dependent children.
policy.catalogContract: Only source files reachable from src/app/(app) belong to the UI Kit product catalog.
